newsitem.title: USA: Texaco names management of production team.
newsitem.headline: Texaco names management of production team.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Wednesday it has named the management team of its worldwide exploration and production activities and realigned those activites from a geographic to a functional orientation on January 1.
The newly formed group, Texaco Worldwide Exploration and Production, will improve communication and cooperation among the company's various units, said the company.
The company said that there were four major units within the group.
North American Producing will be headed by Texaco Inc vice-president Claire Farley.
International Producing is headed by Texaco Inc vice-president Robert Solberg.
New Business Development is headed by Thomas Hazen, vice-president of Texaco Wolrdwide Exploration and Production.
Exploration will be headed by Bruce Applebaum, president of Texaco Exploration.
